metrics.warning: EXPERIMENTAL — NOT VALIDATED FOR PATIENT CARE; synthetic label agreement only

recorded_measurement.definition: Generated proxy; NOT pulse, temperature or another clinical measurement

feature_schema.missingness_rule: Training median/imputation learned only on fit rows; advisory inference abstains for missing inputs
feature_schema.provenance: Independent generated synthetic observations; no clinical measurements or patient identities

metrics.train_rows_definition: Legacy key: all development rows before final holdout; only estimator_fit_rows fit estimator/preprocessor
metrics.selection_reason: Logistic regression chosen for exact additive/contrastive explanations; C selected by model-selection macro F1, ties prefer stronger regularisation; every comparator retained
metrics.cross_validation_definition: Supporting 3-fold stratified CV inside fit rows only; not final performance or hyperparameter selection

calibration.brier_definition: Mean sum of squared class probability errors; range 0 to 2
calibration.interpretation: Scoring rules reflect discrimination and calibration; reliability bins are descriptive, not a clinical guarantee
calibration.method: Independent temperature-fit calibration, evaluated on untouched chronological final test; no clinical calibration claim

calibration_fit.method: Positive scalar temperature fitted on calibration-only logits by log loss

raw.brier_definition: Mean sum of squared class probability errors; range 0 to 2
raw.interpretation: Scoring rules reflect discrimination and calibration; reliability bins are descriptive, not a clinical guarantee

calibrated.brier_definition: Mean sum of squared class probability errors; range 0 to 2
calibrated.interpretation: Scoring rules reflect discrimination and calibration; reliability bins are descriptive, not a clinical guarantee

threshold_selection.objective: Minimise (accepted synthetic-label errors + 0.35 * abstentions) / all threshold-selection rows; ties prefer coverage then lower threshold
threshold_selection.warning: Dimensionless predeclared engineering utility; not an approved clinical acceptance criterion

risk_coverage.denominator: All evaluation rows; missing/unseen/out-of-fit-range inputs abstain at every threshold
risk_coverage.small_sample_warning: Per-class counts and Wilson intervals retained; sparse synthetic groups do not establish fairness

raw_risk_coverage.denominator: All evaluation rows; missing/unseen/out-of-fit-range inputs abstain at every threshold
raw_risk_coverage.small_sample_warning: Per-class counts and Wilson intervals retained; sparse synthetic groups do not establish fairness

heldout_uncertainty.method: Seeded percentile row bootstrap, conditional on fixed fitted model/calibrator/threshold
heldout_uncertainty.boundary_policy: Suppress boundary-degenerate percentile selective-risk intervals; Wilson interval remains primary, including zero observed errors
heldout_uncertainty.limitations: Assumes independent synthetic rows; does not cover model-selection uncertainty, repeated subjects or temporal dependence

learning_curves.uncertainty_note: Wilson row interval conditional on fitted prefix; no model-selection uncertainty
Wilson row interval conditional on fitted prefix; no model-selection uncertainty
Wilson row interval conditional on fitted prefix; no model-selection uncertainty
Wilson row interval conditional on fitted prefix; no model-selection uncertainty

ordinal_comparator.method: Four fixed-C cumulative binary logistic regressions; running-min monotone-tail correction

probability_metrics.brier_definition: Mean sum of squared class probability errors; range 0 to 2
probability_metrics.interpretation: Scoring rules reflect discrimination and calibration; reliability bins are descriptive, not a clinical guarantee

ordinal_comparator.role: Research comparator only; not selected for advisory use
ordinal_comparator.limitation: Uses ordering only, not equal clinical distances; independent boundary fits are not a proportional-odds model

stress_tests.interpretation: Controlled synthetic sensitivity study, not prediction of future performance; changed labels are explicit simulated concept shift
stress_tests.monitoring_limitation: Input-range flags cannot detect all performance changes, especially label shift; no autonomous retraining or activation

monitoring_challenge.threshold_basis: Model-selection partition fraction + 0.20; predeclared engineering rule, not significance or clinical safety
limitations: Resampled synthetic final-test inputs; repeated rows and small windows, not independent clinical evidence
An input shift need not increase error; label shift may leave input alarms silent
Full-classifier error includes guarded/imputed rows and differs from actual suggestion error
Null delay means no detected shift within observation, not immediate detection
Monitoring rules are evaluated offline only; no automatic model or priority change

explanation_stability.method: First 40 eligible chronological holdout rows; original predicted-vs-runner-up pair held fixed for attribution comparison
explanation_stability.limitation: Local input sensitivity, not causal or clinical robustness; labels are not redefined after perturbation

metrics.slice_policy: Synthetic age-band diagnostic; n<30 suppressed. Sex is not collected. No fairness inference.
limitations: No subject identifiers: repeated-subject leakage cannot be ruled out for external data.
Synthetic labels are not clinician ground truth
Temperature calibration may worsen final-test performance; both raw and calibrated outcomes retained
Threshold utility is a research assumption, not a clinical harm function
Unconditional classifier metrics include training-imputed missing inputs; guarded coverage and risk reflect actual advisory eligibility
Observed-at timestamps stand for synthetic prediction time; repeated-subject and retrospective clinical availability are not established
